\section[(dialogue)]{Animals, describing words and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R98-first-pass-animals-describing-words-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a way and a country.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a mountain, a forest, a river, a lake, a stone
  \item sand, a field, a cloud, the sun, the moon
  \item the sea, fire, snow; ice, rain, wind
  \item a dog, a cat, a cow, a goat, a sheep
  \item a bird, a mouse, a lion, an elephant, a monkey
  \item a snake, big, small, new, old
  \item bad, long, hot, slowly, fast
  \item easy, expensive, cheap, high, low
  \item full, empty, clean, sweet, fat
  \item thin, light, heavy, important, green
  \item yellow, red, blue, black, white
  \item brown, a day, evening, morning, a week
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A mountain? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਹਾੜ}}, \emph{pahāṛ}.) A forest? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੰਗਲ}}, \emph{jaṅgal}.) A river? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਰਿਆ}}, \emph{dariā}.) A lake? (\textbf{\pa{ਝੀਲ}}, \emph{jhīl}.) A stone? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੱਥਰ}}, \emph{patthar}.) Sand? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੇਤ}}, \emph{ret}.) A field? (\textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤ}}, \emph{khet}.) A cloud? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੱਦਲ}}, \emph{baddal}.) The sun? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੂਰਜ}}, \emph{sūraj}.) The moon? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੰਨ}}, \emph{chann}.) The sea? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਮੁੰਦਰ}}, \emph{samundar}.) Fire? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਗ}}, \emph{agg}.) Snow; ice? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਰਫ਼}}, \emph{baraf}.) Rain? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੀਂਹ}}, \emph{mīṁh}.) Wind? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਵਾ}}, \emph{havā}.) A dog? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੁੱਤਾ}}, \emph{kuttā}.) A cat? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਿੱਲੀ}}, \emph{billī}.) A cow? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਾਂ}}, \emph{gāṁ}.) A goat? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੱਕਰੀ}}, \emph{bakkrī}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੇਡ}}, \emph{bheḍ}.) A bird? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੰਛੀ}}, \emph{panchhī}.) A mouse? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੂਹਾ}}, \emph{chūhā}.) A lion? (\textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ੇਰ}}, \emph{sher}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਾਥੀ}}, \emph{hāthī}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਂਦਰ}}, \emph{bāndar}.) A snake? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੱਪ}}, \emph{sapp}.) Big? (\textbf{\pa{ਵੱਡਾ}}, \emph{vaḍḍā}.) Small? (\textbf{\pa{ਛੋਟਾ}}, \emph{chhoṭā}.) New? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਵਾਂ}}, \emph{navāṁ}.) Old? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੁਰਾਣਾ}}, \emph{purāṇā}.) Bad? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੁਰਾ}}, \emph{burā}.) Long? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੰਮਾ}}, \emph{lammā}.) Hot? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਰਮ}}, \emph{garam}.) Slowly? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੌਲੀ}}, \emph{haulī}.) Fast? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੇਜ਼}}, \emph{tez}.) Easy? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੌਖਾ}}, \emph{saukhā}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਹਿੰਗਾ}}, \emph{mahiṅgā}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਸਤਾ}}, \emph{sastā}.) High? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਚਾ}}, \emph{uchchā}.) Low? (\textbf{\pa{ਨੀਵਾਂ}}, \emph{nīvāṁ}.) Full? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਰਿਆ}}, \emph{bhariā}.) Empty? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ਾਲੀ}}, \emph{khālī}.) Clean? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਫ਼}}, \emph{sāf}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਿੱਠਾ}}, \emph{miṭṭhā}.) Fat? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੋਟਾ}}, \emph{moṭā}.) Thin? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਤਲਾ}}, \emph{patlā}.) Light? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਲਕਾ}}, \emph{halkā}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਰੀ}}, \emph{bhārī}.) Important? (\textbf{\pa{ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ}}, \emph{zarūrī}.) Green? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਰਾ}}, \emph{harā}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੀਲਾ}}, \emph{pīlā}.) Red? (\textbf{\pa{ਲਾਲ}}, \emph{lāl}.) Blue? (\textbf{\pa{ਨੀਲਾ}}, \emph{nīlā}.) Black? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਲਾ}}, \emph{kālā}.) White? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਿੱਟਾ}}, \emph{chiṭṭā}.) Brown? (\textbf{\pa{ਭੂਰਾ}}, \emph{bhūrā}.) A day? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਿਨ}}, \emph{din}.) Evening? (\textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਾਮ}}, \emph{shām}.) Morning? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਵੇਰ}}, \emph{saver}.) A week? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਫ਼ਤਾ}}, \emph{haftā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R98-second-pass-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a month and a year.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a month, a year, an hour, a minute, today
  \item now, always, a delay; late, before, far
  \item near, inside, outside, on, below
  \item in front, behind, here, there, a shop
  \item a road, a lane, a bank, a station, a car; a train
  \item a bus, a bridge, a gurdwara, a temple, a hotel
  \item the police, a boat, a bicycle, a market, clothes
  \item a kurta, a sock, a pocket, a ring, a watch
  \item a turban, a shoe, a cap, a shirt, six
  \item seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven
  \item twelve, twenty, thirty, fifty, a hundred
  \item a thousand, the world, a colour, a song, a journey
  \item a holiday, love, music, a way, a country
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A month? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਹੀਨਾ}}, \emph{mahīnā}.) A year? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਲ}}, \emph{sāl}.) An hour? (\textbf{\pa{ਘੰਟਾ}}, \emph{ghaṇṭā}.) A minute? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਿੰਟ}}, \emph{minṭ}.) Today? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਜ}}, \emph{ajj}.) Now? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੁਣ}}, \emph{huṇ}.) Always? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ}}, \emph{hameshā}.) A delay; late? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੇਰ}}, \emph{der}.) Before? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਹਿਲਾਂ}}, \emph{pahilāṁ}.) Far? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੂਰ}}, \emph{dūr}.) Near? (\textbf{\pa{ਨੇੜੇ}}, \emph{neṛe}.) Inside? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੰਦਰ}}, \emph{andar}.) Outside? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਹਰ}}, \emph{bāhar}.) On? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਤੇ}}, \emph{utte}.) Below? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੇਠਾਂ}}, \emph{heṭhāṁ}.) In front? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਹਮਣੇ}}, \emph{sāhmaṇe}.) Behind? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿੱਛੇ}}, \emph{pichchhe}.) Here? (\textbf{\pa{ਇੱਥੇ}}, \emph{itthe}.) There? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਥੇ}}, \emph{utthe}.) A shop? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੁਕਾਨ}}, \emph{dukān}.) A road? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੜਕ}}, \emph{saṛak}.) A lane? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਲੀ}}, \emph{galī}.) A bank? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੈਂਕ}}, \emph{baiṅk}.) A station? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨ}}, \emph{saṭeshan}.) A car; a train? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੱਡੀ}}, \emph{gaḍḍī}.) A bus? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੱਸ}}, \emph{bass}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੁਲ}}, \emph{pul}.) A gurdwara? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਾ}}, \emph{gurduārā}.) A temple? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੰਦਰ}}, \emph{mandar}.) A hotel? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੋਟਲ}}, \emph{hoṭal}.) The police? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੁਲਿਸ}}, \emph{pulis}.) A boat? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਿਸ਼ਤੀ}}, \emph{kishtī}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਈਕਲ}}, \emph{sāīkal}.) A market? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰ}}, \emph{bāzār}.) Clothes? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੱਪੜੇ}}, \emph{kappṛe}.) A kurta? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੁੜਤਾ}}, \emph{kuṛtā}.) A sock? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੁਰਾਬ}}, \emph{jurāb}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੇਬ}}, \emph{jeb}.) A ring? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁੰਦਰੀ}}, \emph{mundrī}.) A watch? (\textbf{\pa{ਘੜੀ}}, \emph{ghaṛī}.) A turban? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੱਗ}}, \emph{pagg}.) A shoe? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੁੱਤੀ}}, \emph{juttī}.) A cap? (\textbf{\pa{ਟੋਪੀ}}, \emph{ṭopī}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਮੀਜ਼}}, \emph{kamīz}.) Six? (\textbf{\pa{ਛੇ}}, \emph{chhe}.) Seven? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੱਤ}}, \emph{satt}.) Eight? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਠ}}, \emph{aṭṭh}.) Nine? (\textbf{\pa{ਨੌਂ}}, \emph{nauṁ}.) Ten? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਸ}}, \emph{das}.) Eleven? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਿਆਰਾਂ}}, \emph{giārāṁ}.) Twelve? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਰਾਂ}}, \emph{bārāṁ}.) Twenty? (\textbf{\pa{ਵੀਹ}}, \emph{vīh}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੀਹ}}, \emph{tīh}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਹ}}, \emph{panjāh}.) A hundred? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੌ}}, \emph{sau}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਜ਼ਾਰ}}, \emph{hazār}.) The world? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੁਨੀਆ}}, \emph{dunīā}.) A colour? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੰਗ}}, \emph{raṅg}.) A song? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੀਤ}}, \emph{gīt}.) A journey? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਫ਼ਰ}}, \emph{safar}.) A holiday? (\textbf{\pa{ਛੁੱਟੀ}}, \emph{chhuṭṭī}.) Love? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਿਆਰ}}, \emph{piār}.) Music? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੰਗੀਤ}}, \emph{saṅgīt}.) A way? (\textbf{\pa{ਰਸਤਾ}}, \emph{rastā}.) A country? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੇਸ਼}}, \emph{desh}.)
